class.name: CgamePopulationLOD
class.brief_description: Simulation level of detail for large populations: abstract herds on a region grid with promotion and demotion to concrete agents.
class.description: Far from every player a crowd is not simulated agent by agent. It lives as abstract herds on a coarse grid of regions. A herd has a region, a total count, a composition by type, a heading and a state ([code]"idle"[/code] or [code]"moving"[/code]). Herds migrate along the gradient of attractors (noise, corpses, loot, night) plus a seeded random wander, merge when they meet, split when they grow beyond [member max_herd_size] and are reduced or replenished by decay rates and spawners. When a player gets close, [method promote] converts the herds of a region into concrete spawn specs (conserving counts, bounded by [member max_concrete_agents]) and [method demote] folds despawned agents back into a herd. The simulation is fully deterministic: it uses one seeded random generator, visits herds in ascending id order and never reads the clock. The same seed and calls give the same world. Regions are numbered row by row: [code]region = y * cols + x[/code]. This is the native counterpart of [code]scripts/shared/population_lod.gd[/code].

method.name: abstract_count
method.description: Returns the number of agents represented abstractly (inside herds).

method.name: add_attractor
method.description: Adds an attractor of [param kind] (conventionally [code]"noise"[/code], [code]"corpse"[/code], [code]"loot"[/code] or [code]"night"[/code]). Its pull on a region falls off linearly to zero at [param radius] and is scaled by the kind's weight (see [method set_kind_weight]). [code]"night"[/code] attractors only act while [member night] is on. A negative [param ttl] means permanent; otherwise the attractor expires after that many seconds of [method tick] time.

method.name: add_herd
method.description: Adds a herd in [param region]. [param composition] maps type names to counts; entries with a count of zero or less are ignored. Returns the new herd id, or [code]-1[/code] (and prints an error) for an invalid region or non-numeric count.

method.name: add_spawner
method.description: Adds a nest: [param rate] agents of [param type] per second appear in [param region] while its abstract population stays below [param cap].

method.name: attraction
method.description: Returns the combined attractor pull on [param region], refreshing the cached field first.

method.name: clear_attractors
method.description: Removes all attractors.

method.name: composition_total
method.description: Returns how many agents of [param type] exist across all herds.

method.name: demote
method.description: Folds concrete agents back into the abstract population of [param region]. Each entry is a [Dictionary] with a [code]"type"[/code] key or a plain type [String]. The concrete counter decreases by the number of agents but never below zero, so demoting foreign agents just adds them to the herds.

method.name: get_cell_size
method.description: Returns the region edge length set by [method setup].

method.name: get_cols
method.description: Returns the number of region columns.

method.name: get_concrete_count
method.description: Returns the number of agents currently promoted and not yet demoted.

method.name: get_herd
method.description: Returns a snapshot of a herd with the keys [code]id[/code], [code]region[/code], [code]count[/code], [code]comp[/code] (type to count), [code]heading[/code], [code]state[/code], [code]pos[/code], [code]from[/code], [code]to[/code], [code]t[/code], [code]travel[/code] and [code]timer[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary for an unknown id. Modifying the snapshot does not change the herd.

method.name: get_kind_weight
method.description: Returns the relative pull of an attractor kind. Unknown kinds weigh [code]1.0[/code]. Defaults are noise 1.0, corpse 0.6, loot 0.5 and night 0.3.

method.name: get_origin
method.description: Returns the world position of the grid's top-left corner.

method.name: get_rows
method.description: Returns the number of region rows.

method.name: has_herd
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a herd with this id exists.

method.name: herd_count
method.description: Returns the number of herds.

method.name: herd_ids
method.description: Returns all herd ids in ascending order.

method.name: herd_region_count
method.description: Returns the number of agents in herds located in [param region].

method.name: is_blocked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if herds may not migrate into [param region].

method.name: is_night
method.description: Returns the night flag. See [member night].

method.name: promote
method.description: Converts herds of [param region] into an array of spawn specs, each a [Dictionary] with [code]type[/code], [code]position[/code] and [code]heading[/code]. Nothing is promoted unless a player is within [member promote_radius] (plus half a region) of the region centre; if [param player_positions] is empty the positions of the last [method tick] are used. At most [member max_concrete_agents] minus [method get_concrete_count] agents are produced; the rest stay in their herd, and a request with no budget left is counted in the [code]promote_denied[/code] statistic. The total population is conserved.

method.name: region_cell
method.description: Returns the grid coordinates of [param region].

method.name: region_center
method.description: Returns the world position of the centre of [param region].

method.name: region_count
method.description: Returns [code]cols * rows[/code].

method.name: region_of
method.description: Returns the region containing [param pos]. Positions outside the grid are clamped to the nearest region.

method.name: regions_near
method.description: Returns regions that contain at least one agent and whose centre is within the promote reach of any of [param positions].

method.name: set_blocked
method.description: Blocks or unblocks [param region] for herd migration.

method.name: set_decay
method.description: Herds inside [param region] lose [param rate] agents per second (fire, base defences). A rate of zero or less removes the hazard.

method.name: set_kind_weight
method.description: Sets the relative pull of an attractor kind.

method.name: set_night
method.description: Sets the night flag. See [member night].

method.name: setup
method.description: (Re)initialises the grid ([param cols] and [param rows] are clamped to 1..16384, [param cell_size] to at least 1), seeds the random generator and clears all herds, attractors, hazards, spawners, statistics and the concrete counter. Tunable properties keep their values.

method.name: stats
method.description: Returns counters: [code]migrations[/code], [code]merges[/code], [code]splits[/code], [code]promotions[/code], [code]demotions[/code], [code]spawned[/code], [code]decayed[/code], [code]promote_denied[/code], plus [code]herds[/code], [code]abstract[/code], [code]concrete[/code], [code]total[/code] and [code]budget_left[/code].

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param dt] seconds: ages attractors, moves herds, then merges, splits and applies decay and spawner rules. [param player_positions] are remembered for later [method promote] calls.

method.name: total_population
method.description: Returns abstract plus promoted agents.

members.member: Region edge length in world units. Read-only; set by [method setup].
Number of region columns. Read-only; set by [method setup].
Agents currently promoted and not yet demoted. Read-only.
Seconds a herd idles in a region before moving on (randomised by 0.5 to 1.5).
Herd travel speed in world units per second during the day.
Herds merge only up to this size and split when they exceed it.
Preference for keeping the current heading when choosing the next region.
Night mode: [code]"night"[/code] attractors become active, herds move faster by [member night_speed_mult] and wander half as much.
World position of the grid's top-left corner. Read-only; set by [method setup].
Distance from a player within which a region may be promoted.
Weight of the random wander term when choosing the next region.
Number of region rows. Read-only; set by [method setup].
